title: Academy Help Center
welcomeMessage: Welcome to Customer Service! Choose the topic you'd like to ask about:

ui.defaultLink: Go to the page for details

questions.question: How do I apply for a course or program?
answerPoints: Open the Courses or Programs page and pick what suits you.
Click the Apply button and fill in your basic details.
You'll find your request under "My Applications" and can track its status there.

questions.question: Where are the cohorts held?
answerPoints: In-person cohorts are held at the Alexandria branch.
Room details and start date are listed on each course page.
If a cohort is full, you can join the waiting list or pick the nearest start date.

questions.question: What's the difference between a course, a program, and a career path?
answerPoints: Course: standalone study in a single subject.
Program: a group of related courses ending with a graduation project.
Career path: a complete plan of several programs toward a specific job goal.

questions.question: Can I pay in installments?
answerPoints: Yes, installment plans are available for most programs.
Contact the admissions team to arrange a plan before the cohort starts.

questions.question: Where can I track my payments and receipts?
answerPoints: Sign in, then open the "Payments" page from the side menu.
You'll see all your transactions and their status (in progress / successful / failed / refunded).

questions.question: How do I create an account and verify my email?
answerPoints: Click Create an account and enter your details.
You'll receive an email with a verification code (OTP).
Enter the code on the verification page to activate your account.

questions.question: I forgot my password. What should I do?
answerPoints: On the sign-in page, choose "Forgot password?".
Enter your email and you'll receive a message to reset it.

questions.question: Are the certificates accredited?
answerPoints: Our programs carry Pearson and CPD accreditation, as shown on each program page.
You receive the certificate after successfully completing the program.

questions.question: Where do I find my schedule, materials, and assignments?
answerPoints: After you're accepted and enrolled, open "Workspace" from your account.
You'll find the schedule, assignments, materials, and messages in separate tabs.

contactUs.label: Can't find your question? Contact us on WhatsApp
contactUs.defaultMessage: Hello, I have a question that isn't in the FAQ list.
